responsibility: Compiles closed MASTER and exact-match TASK policy documents into one task-contract-bound immutable envelope or refuses.
reads: validated structured policy documents supplied in process
one frozen task-contract identity and hash
execution_location: in-process pure deterministic compilation with no store, provider, model, network or host action
failure_boundary: fail_closed — missing MASTER policy, unknown fields or effects, selector ambiguity, invalid or cyclic supersession, applicable conflict, HOLD, task widening, malformed binding and non-recomputing envelopes all refuse compilation
recovery_behavior: Correct the structured source or exact selector and compile again; no failed compilation mutates authority or leaves partial state
replacement_contract: A replacement must retain the closed schema, exact four-dimensional selector, unconditional MASTER inheritance, additive or narrowing-only TASK composition, canonical ordering, full active selected-document policy-set hash, the minimal supersession ancestry required for independent envelope recompilation, independent envelope hash domain and task-contract binding
evidence_produced: immutable in-memory policy envelope carrying the active selected policy ids, their supersession ancestry, and effective prohibitions, checks, evidence and scope
domain-separated hashes for the MASTER baseline, selected full policy content and final task-contract-bound envelope
